title: Marcos Jr visits tomb of father ahead of All Saints' Day celebration
summary: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. visited the tomb of his father, former President Ferdinand E. Marcos Sr., at the Libingan ng mga Bayani ahead of the observance of All Saints’ Day.
